verdict.rationale: The Agent API supplies autonomous building blocks: presets that give a working agent, multi-step tool use (web search, URL fetch, code sandbox), reusable versioned profiles, and model fallback. These let a developer build an agent that runs without supervision inside a request. However, nothing shows first-party background execution, scheduling, triggers or recurring jobs, so users must provide their own scheduler and orchestration. Missing for 10: native scheduled or triggered automations, background/async run mode with status or notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended operation.
